item.title: Trajectory-Level Speculation with Semantic Verification for Tool-Using Agents
item.description:
SpecAgent lets a heavy‑weight LLM delegate routine tool‑calling steps to a smaller model, then verifies the smaller model’s output using semantic checks before committing. This reduces the number of expensive LLM calls while keeping accuracy high, saving compute and cost. Not directly relevant to everyday cloud infra management.

item.title: [News] New Microsoft data innovations unlock what only your business knows
item.description: Microsoft has introduced new data‑centric AI capabilities designed to leverage the unique knowledge within each organization. These innovations aim to enhance how businesses uncover insights from their own data assets.

item.title: [News] Replit makes OpenAI its default over Anthropic, CEO says
item.description: Replit has switched its default AI model provider from Anthropic’s Claude to OpenAI, while still keeping Claude available for users. The change means all new Replit code assistants and AI-driven features will now leverage OpenAI’s models by default.

item.title: [News] Meta removes language that raised scraping and AI training concerns
item.description: Meta has updated its terms to remove language that raised concerns about web scraping and AI training, asserting no change in its crawling practices.

item.title: [News] Anthropic says its workforce has become less junior and is spending more time in meetings
[News] Stack Overflow for Agents triples signups with ChatGPT plugin
item.description: OpenAI released a ChatGPT plugin that boosts Stack Overflow for Agents signups by up to tenfold, thanks to rapid integration with Codex. This demonstrates the power of conversational AI to accelerate developer tooling adoption.
